title: Pretty Print
text: Pretty Print. While I do love the pretty print of this Vera Bradley storage bin, I'm not a fan of the design. It doesn't hold the round shape at all. I thought it might take some time since it was folded flat, but it's been at least a week and it's still in an awkward shape. I could see this being a useful storage item for a college student, but it's a little disappointing for this 50 something mom.
